title: Interest Rate Basics
slides: Interest is the extra amount paid for using borrowed money.
A lower rate can reduce your monthly EMI and the total cost of the loan.
Always compare the rate, tenure, and processing fee before choosing a partner.
question: What usually reduces the total cost of a loan?

title: What Is Moratorium?
slides: A moratorium is a short pause before regular repayment begins.
It can help when your business or course needs time before income starts.
Interest may still build during this period, so ask clearly before signing.

title: Keep Documents Ready
slides: Most applications need identity, address, income, and caste certificates.
Uploading clear documents early can reduce back-and-forth with the branch.
Only share documents after reading the consent purpose.
question: When should you share documents?

title: Avoid Middlemen
slides: VittSetu does not charge citizens for checking schemes or starting applications.
Do not pay anyone who promises guaranteed approval.
Report suspicious agents from the safety banner or your profile.
question: What should you do if someone asks for money to submit?

title: Credit Score Basics
slides: A credit score reflects past repayment behavior.
Paying EMIs on time helps build a stronger credit history.
If a score is unavailable, ask the partner what alternate checks they use.
question: What helps build credit history?

title: Nearest Is Not Always Best
slides: A nearby branch may still have low capacity.
VittSetu ranks partners using availability signals and distance together.
Choose a partner that can realistically process your application.
question: What should you check besides distance?

title: Know Your Grievance Rights
slides: If your application stalls, you can raise a grievance inside VittSetu.
The tracker shows a service deadline so you know when to follow up.
Keep your case ID for future reference.
question: Why is a case ID useful?

title: Sign Carefully
slides: A signature confirms that you understand and agree to submit.
Read the summary before signing any real application.
The VittSetu signature pad in this demo is only for prototype flow.
